title: xi dats ability action
description: Publish a composed ability presentation (job ability / spell / weapon skill built by `xi ability compose` from a recipe — schema ability_recipe.json) into ROM10 with a new animation number. `dats new` (Ability) and `dats prepare recipe.json --type ability` write it; `dats build` composes the recipe, places the DAT(s) and registers their file ids.

kind.description: What the client looks the DAT up as. auto = from the recipe: a race-bound `ws:` lane publishes as a weapon skill (per-race extended slot), a `spell:` motion as a spell (file_id 0xAF0 + animation), anything else as a job ability (file_id 4412 + animation).

animation.description: Animation number the server row will carry. auto = the first free one: job abilities from 339, spells the first unregistered from 1012, weapon skills the first extended slot (264–271) whose DAT is a retail dummy on every race — then, for each kind, the custom band a client running a band plugin loads (xi_config FX_*_BAND_*: weapon skills 272–527 with cexislots).

animation_from.description: Where an auto animation number starts: the first free one at or above this, instead of the first free one of all (e.g. 272 to go straight to the weapon-skill custom band). A rebuild keeps the number it already has unless that is now below this.

subdir.description: ROM10 folder the DAT(s) are placed in (first free file numbers).

recipe.description: The recipe (ability_recipe.json), relative to projects/resources: ability/<slug>.mix.json (a mix file; older manifests name ability/<slug>.recipe.json, which still builds).

force.description: Repoint an animation number that is already registered (never done on its own).

emit.description: Write the server SQL snippet as <slug>_<animation>.sql into the publish folder projects/abilities/<slug>/ (<slug> = the id's last part). The folder takes a copy of every DAT placed and placements.json (ability_publish.json) either way.

result.description: Recorded by dats build: the allocation the action landed on.

server.description: The SQL the build wrote: projects/abilities/<slug>/<slug>_<animation>.sql (earlier builds: projects/server/abilities/<slug>/<slug>_<animation>.sql, and before the publish folder projects/server/abilities/<slug>_<animation>.sql).

db.description: Database Update (dats build --apply-db): the server row this action is bound to. Carried over by every build; dats undo --apply-db reverts it. Never holds a credential: `server` is database@host:port.

id.description: The row's primary key (spellid, abilityId, weaponskillid).

name.description: The row's name (the recipe name in lower case for a row this action created).

created.description: This action inserted the row (cloned from `like`); undo deletes it.

confirmed.description: The row existed and was confirmed once (--db-row); later publishes update it without asking.

like.description: The donor a created row was cloned from — also the donor of its menu record and Lua stub.

group.description: spell_list.group of a spell row (its script folder).

before.description: The row as the first write to it found it (null for a created row); undo puts `animation` back.

at.description: UTC time of the last op (ISO 8601).

menu.description: Client Menu Record (dats build --menu-record): the client spell / command record placed at the server row's id, per build root. dats undo puts back what each root's row held while it still holds `written`.

server_id.description: The server id: spell N is mgc_[N], job ability A comm[A+512], weapon skill W comm[W].

name.description: The name the menu shows (EN and JP).

provisional.description: The id was chosen without the database; the next publish with Database Update keeps it if it is free.

roots.description: Per build target (dir, pivot): the record written there.

replaced.description: What the row held before (xi_menu_table.capture_record): {record, blocks}.

written.description: Hex of the record written; a row still holding it is this action's own.

lua.description: Lua Stub (dats build --lua-stub): the server script written for a row this action created. dats undo --apply-db deletes it while it is unedited.

sha256.description: Hash of the whole file as written.

undone.description: Set by dats undo when it cleared this action's DATs and table entries but kept the manifest because a database row or Lua stub is still there, or a menu record couldn't be put back (UTC, ISO 8601). Such a record stays in result.menu (only the roots that failed) and the next undo tries it again. The next build drops it.
